_comment: Single source of truth. Both the PreToolUse gate (scripts/docs-gate.mjs) and the mdfile skill read this file. Changing the required doc set is a data edit, never a code edit.
_allowExtensions: Writes to these extensions are never blocked. Removing .md deadlocks the gate: it would block the very documents it demands.
_allowFilenames: Matched case-insensitively against the basename. Project manifests are here so the skill has something to profile on a greenfield project instead of asking the user everything.
_stateFile: Written only by `/precode:docs skip`, never by the gate. Relative to the project root. Safe to commit: it is a team-wide decision.
